meaning: The star packages of this repository that the map does not name or open by click: each is one more star of the galaxy, a dot at its own prepared place in its own color. Each keeps its page, reached by search.

appearance.colorLevelsBasis: Presentation choice, 2026-10-02: eight steps a channel leave 27 colors for the 2,113 stars (2026-10-03), about as many as the rest of the galaxy's dots use (24); every star's own color would be 1,276 paint paths.
